name: Warden Hywel

intro.text: Authentic Dragon Scales! Hand-sourced from a genuine dragon! Mind the crisp-bag, I mean, scale.
You doubt our scales? Our scales have a QR code!

win: Oh. They ARE crisps. I'll just, er, put the stall away.
after: Salt and vinegar, mostly. The cheese and onion are hatchlings.
